title: Work-tape bounds during a computation
statement: Let $N$ be an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine, $O$ an oracle language, $x$ an input word, and $w$ a finite sequence of choice bits. In the resulting configuration, every work-tape head is within distance $|w|$ of cell $0$. Moreover, for every work tape and every integer cell position $z$ with $|w|\le |z|$, that cell is blank.
